releaseNotes:
• Instagram & Restricted App Redirection Fix: BlockingActivity elevated via singleTask and dedicated taskAffinity with FLAG_ACTIVITY_REORDER_TO_FRONT and Android 14+ background launch permissions
• BAL & OEM Displacement Safety Fallback: Automatically displaces restricted apps to Home within 250ms if background launch is silently suppressed by OEM battery/window policies
• Live Cache Reconcile: AppDetailsViewModel and AppSelectionViewModel automatically sync in-memory cache on limit updates and toggles
• Zero-Second Immediate Blocking: Applications configured with 0-second limits are blocked instantly without waiting for usage records
